Sandbox_TheChosenOne_KnoxImmunityChanceP: Percentage chance that a newly created character is naturally immune to the Knox infection.
Sandbox_TheChosenOne_EnableKnoxFever_too: If enabled, immune characters experience Knox infection progression until the infection's maximum-health cap reaches the configured recovery threshold.
Sandbox_TheChosenOne_KnoxMaxHealthThresh: When Knox fever is enabled, clear the Knox infection when its infection-only maximum-health cap reaches this percentage.
